title: BECE Physical Education - Physical & Health Education - Human Development
subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: The period of transition from childhood to adulthood is known as ________.
questions.explain: Adolescence is the phase between childhood and adulthood.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which of the following is a primary sexual characteristic in males?
questions.explain: Primary characteristics relate directly to reproductive organs (sperm production), while voice and hair are secondary.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Menstruation in females is the monthly shedding of the lining of the ________.
questions.explain: Menstruation is the discharge of the uterine lining (endometrium).
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which gland is often called the 'master gland' affecting growth during puberty?
questions.explain: The pituitary gland releases hormones that control growth and other glands.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.explain: On average, girls enter puberty 1-2 years earlier than boys.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: A common emotional change during adolescence is ________.
questions.explain: Hormonal changes often cause mood swings during adolescence.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Ovulation is the release of a mature egg from the ________.
questions.explain: Ovulation involves the release of an ovum (egg) from the ovary.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which hormone is primarily responsible for male secondary sexual characteristics?
questions.explain: Testosterone drives the development of male secondary sexual traits like facial hair and voice deepening.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education
